Codex review: keeping this open for maintainer follow-up; there is still a little grit to resolve. _Reviewed September 4, 2026, 8:20 PM ET / September 5, 2026, 00:20 UTC._

**Summary**
Keep open: the reported release and current main use the same active chat renderer and dependency version. Older list-clipping fixes cover a different renderer and do not establish that this report is resolved.

Reproducibility: no. high-confidence current-main reproduction is established. The reporter reproduced the symptom twice, but the complete Markdown, pane width, and display scaling are missing, and this read-only review did not run native WinUI.

**Ways to help us reproduce this**
- Add a screenshot or short recording showing the behavior.
- Add expected vs actual behavior.

**Next step**
Obtain the complete failing Markdown, pane width, and display scaling, then establish a mounted Windows reproduction before choosing an application-side or dependency repair.


<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

Best possible solution:

Make long list text wrap within the available assistant-bubble width in the active Reactor path, preserving complete selectable text and inert Markdown handling.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue?

No high-confidence current-main reproduction is established. The reporter reproduced the symptom twice, but the complete Markdown, pane width, and display scaling are missing, and this read-only review did not run native WinUI.

Is this the best way to solve the issue?

Unclear until the failing layout is localized; a focused repair in the active Reactor rendering path is preferable to changing or restoring the legacy renderer whose list tests already pass structurally.

AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant.

Remaining risk / open question:

- Without the complete failing Markdown and mounted layout measurements, the fault cannot yet be localized to application width constraints or Reactor's list rendering.

Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning high; reviewed against [3dcf7cab220f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/3dcf7cab220f87c0c7e98ac31363f80e7d00d6f9).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Evidence reviewed</summary>

What I checked:

- **Concrete report on an official release:** The supplied issue body reports two occurrences on v2026.7.1-4, with bullet text disappearing around 105–110 characters while identical content remains readable in the browser Control UI. It does not include the complete failing Markdown or window measurements. The captured discussion contains no additional human reproduction or linked fix.
- **Active rendering owner and dependency boundary:** Assistant text reaches BuildSafeMarkdown at line 439; its result sits in a bubble with MaxWidth(720). BuildSafeMarkdown delegates sanitized text to Microsoft.UI.Reactor's Factories.Markdown. The production project explicitly references Microsoft.UI.Reactor 0.1.0-preview.12, establishing that dependency's relevance without establishing a defect inside it. ([`src/OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI/Chat/ReactorChatTimeline.cs:548`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/3dcf7cab220f87c0c7e98ac31363f80e7d00d6f9/src/OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI/Chat/ReactorChatTimeline.cs#L548), [3dcf7cab220f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/3dcf7cab220f87c0c7e98ac31363f80e7d00d6f9))
- **Reported release and main have identical relevant files:** The v2026.7.1-4 tag resolves to c7c6fb06be036de512d824986a6eee6eca14abdb. Comparing that release with the reviewed main revision produced no differences in the active timeline renderer, sanitizer, or production project dependency declarations. No later fix for this rendering path was established. ([`src/OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI/Chat/ReactorChatTimeline.cs:548`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/3dcf7cab220f87c0c7e98ac31363f80e7d00d6f9/src/OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI/Chat/ReactorChatTimeline.cs#L548), [3dcf7cab220f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/3dcf7cab220f87c0c7e98ac31363f80e7d00d6f9))
- **Earlier clipping coverage does not test production chat:** MarkdownRendererListTests describe the previous horizontal-stack clipping bug and assert Grid or RichTextBlock shapes in the older FunctionalUI renderer. Production call-site inspection finds that renderer used by CronPage, not the current chat surfaces. These tests define the intended wrapping behavior but cannot disprove the reported Reactor failure. ([`tests/OpenClaw.Tray.UITests/MarkdownRendererListTests.cs:9`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/3dcf7cab220f87c0c7e98ac31363f80e7d00d6f9/tests/OpenClaw.Tray.UITests/MarkdownRendererListTests.cs#L9), [3dcf7cab220f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/3dcf7cab220f87c0c7e98ac31363f80e7d00d6f9))
- **Current native proof does not exercise long bullets:** The mounted Reactor Markdown test calls the production BuildSafeMarkdown entrypoint at a 320-pixel width and checks table cells plus a literal code fence. Its fixture contains no bullet list, so its assertions do not establish long-list wrapping. ([`tests/OpenClaw.Tray.UITests/ReactorMarkdownTableProofTests.cs:35`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/3dcf7cab220f87c0c7e98ac31363f80e7d00d6f9/tests/OpenClaw.Tray.UITests/ReactorMarkdownTableProofTests.cs#L35), [3dcf7cab220f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/3dcf7cab220f87c0c7e98ac31363f80e7d00d6f9))
- **Architecture rules exclude restoring the retired chat path:** The architecture ledger makes ReactorChatTimeline authoritative for production chat and marks the legacy FunctionalUI default mount closed. A repair should target the active rendering boundary rather than restore the old chat implementation. ([`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:211`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/3dcf7cab220f87c0c7e98ac31363f80e7d00d6f9/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#L211), [3dcf7cab220f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/3dcf7cab220f87c0c7e98ac31363f80e7d00d6f9))
